# Signup Flow Optimizer

`signup-flow-optimizer` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Conversion & Web
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/signup-flow-optimizer/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which parts of our signup flow cost us the most signups, and what should we remove or test first?

**Inputs:** The current flow step by step, every field and whether it's required, monthly visitors reaching step one, current conversion rate, and the value of a signup

**Output:** A friction score with the penalty breakdown, fixes ranked by monthly value, the rebuilt flow specified step by step, and what to test first

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill signup-flow-optimizer`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/signup-flow-optimizer/resources/friction-score.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/signup-flow-optimizer/resources/friction-score.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Input it doesn't recognise produces the default demo flow rather than an error. It reads command-line options only, so a JSON object or an unknown flag is ignored; check the result reflects your numbers.
- Opportunity figures are capped at the friction-blocked share of non-converters (15% by default) and split by directional B2B SaaS priors. They rank fixes; they don't forecast conversion.
- Only the yes/no blocking flags get a monthly value. Extra fields and steps lower the score but don't appear as valued fixes, so a field-heavy flow can show no opportunity.
- It scores the form, not the offer or lead quality. Dropping qualifying fields can lift signups while flooding sales with poor leads or lowering activation.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the signup flow walks the live flow on a phone to confirm the fields, steps and flags entered, and the sales lead confirms which fields qualification needs. Test one change at a time, measured on signups and activation.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/signup-flow-optimizer](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/signup-flow-optimizer)
